description.text: Norrsken is a non-profit impact ecosystem connecting founders with the capital, knowledge and network they need to make saving the world their business.Because if they win, we all win.

targetApplicants.text: Norrsken Houses bring founders, funders, operators and advocates together to build, connect, and scale. Each House operates independently, with its own community and programming shaped by the region it serves.
